description:
## Player button geometry

- Countdown ring is now circular and attached to the Yandex icon in portrait, landscape, and compact players.
- The inside timer replaces the glyph instead of overlapping it.
- The below-icon timer stays inside the existing button footprint.
- The Yandex glyph no longer shifts while controls refresh.

## Full Yandex proxy

- The proxy setting now routes session creation, translation requests, status polling, source-audio uploads, recovery requests, and translated audio through the configured VOT worker.
- Direct Yandex connections remain unchanged when proxy is disabled.
- Large source-audio uploads are wrapped for the worker as a stream to reduce Android memory pressure.

## Testing

This is a preview build based on stable Morphe Patches 1.37.0. Enable pre-release patches for this source in Morphe Manager. Regional proxy behavior still needs real-world testing without a full-device VPN.
